headline_marked: Controversy: [[State Minister Ishraque Ahmed resigns]] after gun-in-hand 'drug drive'
headline: Controversy: State Minister Ishraque Ahmed resigns after gun-in-hand 'drug drive'
summary: The minister resigned to avoid embarrassing the party, claiming he carried firearms for security during an anti-drug operation.
details: State Minister Ishraque Ahmed has resigned from his post following a controversy surrounding an anti-drug operation where he was seen carrying firearms.
caption:
A State Minister resigns after being seen with guns during a 'drug drive'.

State Minister Ishraque Ahmed has resigned from his post following a controversy surrounding an anti-drug operation where he was seen carrying firearms.

#Bangladesh #Politics #IshraqueAhmed #Resignation #News

Source: Prothom Alo, Jamuna TV, bdnews24.com, Dhaka Tribune

headline_marked: Tragedy strikes: [[Siblings killed, parents injured]] in crash en route to Puja
headline: Tragedy strikes: Siblings killed, parents injured in crash en route to Puja
summary: A family's journey to celebrate Durga Puja celebrations ended in tragedy as a road accident claimed the lives of two children.
details: A devastating road accident occurred as a family was traveling to attend Puja celebrations.
The crash resulted in the deaths of two siblings, while their parents were injured in the collision.
The incident has cast a shadow over the festive season as the family sought to join in the festivities.
Local authorities are investigating the cause of the crash to determine how the accident happened.
caption:
A family's journey to celebrate Puja ended in tragedy.

A devastating road accident occurred as a family was traveling to attend Puja celebrations.

The crash resulted in the deaths of two siblings, while their parents were injured in the collision.

The incident has cast a shadow over the festive season as the family sought to join in the festivities.

Local authorities are investigating the cause of the crash to determine how the accident happened.
